known_facts_book1: Underground elves ruled by King Roquat the Red, dwelling in jeweled caverns beneath the mountains of Ev.
Are immortals but not strong on magic.
Dig the tunnel under the Deadly Desert toward the Emerald City, being used to making tunnels.
Fifty thousand of them, General Guph's army, wait massed in the caverns to invade Oz.
Are ordered to wait in the tunnel and, after Roquat forgets everything, are sent marching home.

known_relations_book1.Nome King: Their ruler Roquat, who leads them against Oz.
known_relations_book1.General Guph: Their general, who commands the Nome army.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler of Oz they are sent to conquer and enslave.

not_in_this_book: the Nomes are allies of Oz
the Nomes conquer the Emerald City

hallucination_signals: the Nomes befriend the Oz people

known_facts_book1: Gigantic creatures of bone, skin and muscle, so strong the weakest can toss an elephant seven miles.
Live in the Ripple Land beyond Ev and are surly, unsociable and hated by everyone.
Are ruled by the Grand Gallipoot and recruited by General Guph to invade Oz.
Drink at the Forbidden Fountain and forget their enmity, becoming harmless.

known_relations_book1.General Guph: The Nome general who recruits them.
known_relations_book1.Nome King: Roquat, whose invasion of Oz they join.

not_in_this_book: the Growleywogs are allies of Ozma
the Growleywogs are gentle and kind

known_facts_book1: Erbs who live atop the dread Mountain of Phantastico, the most dangerous of all the invaders.
Are dreaded by mortals and immortals alike, so that no one had approached their mountain for thousands of years.
Can take on false hairy skins and beast heads, their true forms unknown.
Are led by the First and Foremost and recruited by General Guph to invade Oz first, ahead of all others.
Leap up first at the Forbidden Fountain, drink the Water of Oblivion, and forget everything.

known_relations_book1.General Guph: The Nome general who recruits them.

not_in_this_book: the Phanfasms are allies of Oz
the Phanfasms defend the Emerald City
the Phanfasms are killed in battle

hallucination_signals: the Phanfasms are slain in battle

known_facts_book1: The ruler of the Whimsies, burly creatures with heads no bigger than door-knobs who wear big false pasteboard heads.
Has as little wisdom as the others and was made chief only because none was any wiser.
Wears a false head with blue hair, a turned-up nose and big painted green eyes.
Is recruited by General Guph to join the invasion of Oz.
His Whimsies cast off their false heads to drink at the Forbidden Fountain and forget their enmity.

known_relations_book1.General Guph: The Nome general who recruits him and the Whimsies.
known_relations_book1.Nome King: Roquat, whose invasion of Oz the Whimsies join.

not_in_this_book: the Chief of the Whimsies is Ozma's ally
the Whimsies are wise and clever

hallucination_signals: the Chief of the Whimsies befriends Ozma
